page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.sn2ne.4xlarge is a general-purpose virtual machine instance powered by the KVM hypervisor. It features an Intel Xeon E5-2682v4 processor operating at 2.5 GHz on the x86_64 architecture. The instance provides 16 dedicated vCPUs derived from 8 physical cores with hyper-threading enabled. It is equipped with 64.0 GB of system memory, yielding a balanced 4.0 GB of RAM per core. This instance does not include local storage or dedicated GPU hardware, relying instead on network-attached storage and a baseline network bandwidth of 3 Gbps.

Performance benchmarks reveal a clear distinction between single-core and multi-core capabilities. Single-core performance is relatively weak, with stress-ng and Geekbench single-core scores falling into the bottom 25% and 10% categories respectively. Single-threaded tasks like gzip compression and bzip3 decompression also show poor throughput. However, the instance leverages its 16 dedicated vCPUs to deliver average multi-core performance across stress-ng, Geekbench, and PassMark CPU tests. Memory bandwidth for both cached and uncached reads remains in the average tier, supporting steady multi-threaded operations.

Given its hardware profile, the ecs.sn2ne.4xlarge offers moderate qualitative cost efficiency for workloads that can parallelize tasks to overcome lower single-core speeds. It is well-suited for multi-threaded applications such as static web serving, Redis database operations, and software compilation. It can also handle light LLM inference tasks for small models, though performance drops significantly on larger models. It is not recommended for single-threaded processing or workloads requiring high-speed local storage.
